separation_from_primary_matrix: The 78-cell perturbation matrix uses seed 0 only. Seeds 1-9 are a separate numerical evidence plane and are not additional robustness cells.
diagnostics_required: BIC_M0, BIC_M1, BIC_M2 and both selection margins per seed
formal M1 center/period per seed regardless of selection status, with selected-period outcome kept separate
parameter vector/payload hash per model and seed
unique parameter payload count per model
summaries: classification discordance count and fraction versus seed 0
incomplete_seed_policy: Preserve INCOMPLETE_NUMERICAL; do not impute or rerun with a different scientific configuration after seeing results.
